description: This Java class 'CalendarInstanceRepositoryWrapper' provides a wrapper around the 'CalendarInstanceRepository' to handle retrieval and persistence operations for 'CalendarInstance' objects, including exception handling when instances are not found.

classes.name: CalendarInstanceRepositoryWrapper
classes.description: A service class that wraps the repository for CalendarInstance, providing methods to find, save, delete, and handle not found exceptions.

methods.name: findOneWithNotFoundDetection
methods.description: Retrieves a CalendarInstance by ID, throwing an exception if not found.

methods.name: saveAndFlush
methods.description: Saves and immediately flushes the CalendarInstance to the database.
